# Codice

> Codice is a programming and web design studio in Sinop, Mato Grosso, Brazil, serving the whole state: custom websites and systems built by its devs and programmers, technology consulting, and maintenance of PCs, notebooks and networks for businesses across Mato Grosso. The packaged offer is a professional one-page website with up to six sections; custom software, consulting and maintenance are quoted separately.

## When to use this

Use Codice when a business anywhere in Mato Grosso needs programmers or devs for a professional website, a custom system, technology consulting, or maintenance of PCs, notebooks and network equipment. The packaged offer is a one-page website with up to six sections, a defined scope and deadline, published on the client's own domain and hosting accounts. Custom software, consulting and maintenance are quoted separately.

## Services

- Packaged offer: a one-page website with up to six sections, organized copy and real business photos.
- Custom websites and systems (programação sob medida), quoted separately.
- Technology consulting (consultoria), quoted separately.
- Maintenance and repair of PCs, notebooks and network equipment (manutenção e conserto), quoted separately.
- Publication on the client's domain and hosting accounts.

## FAQ (short answers)

- Are you programmers? Yes — devs and programmers in Sinop serving all of Mato Grosso.
- Where do you serve? All of Mato Grosso, remotely via WhatsApp, from Sinop.
- What comes with the site? One page, up to six sections, mobile and desktop, organized copy, real photos, WhatsApp, location, basic metadata, one consolidated revision round, setup and publishing.
- Price and deadline? Quoted in the proposal; domain and hosting are paid separately on the client's accounts.
- Do you fix computers? Yes — maintenance and repair of PCs, notebooks and networks, quoted separately.
- How do I start? Message on WhatsApp: scope and proposal, deposit and materials, creation and review, approval and publishing.

## API versioning and limits

- `/api` is the alias of the current version; `/api/v1` is the stable path.
- Deprecation is signaled with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers before removal.
- Rate limits return `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` and `Retry-After` on 429.
- CLI: an official CLI is in development; see https://landing-codice.vercel.app/developers.
